# truenas_iscsi_target_extent (Resource)

Create an Associated Target.

`lunid` will be automatically assigned if it is not provided based on the `target`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extent` (Number) ID of the iSCSI extent to associate with the target.
- `target` (Number) ID of the iSCSI target to associate with the extent.

### Optional

- `lunid` (Number) LUN ID to assign or `null` to auto-assign the next available LUN.
- `unset` (List of String) Attributes to clear, by name. An attribute this configuration does not mention is left as the server has it; naming it here removes the value instead. Only attributes that accept an empty value can be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_iscsi_target_extent.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_iscsi_target_extent.example 1
```
